copy.headline: Breezy, near-freezing ‘festive chill’ grips North Texas for Thanksgiving
copy.caption:
A "festive chill" is keeping North Texas bundled up in layers this Thanksgiving, with gusty winds making afternoon highs feel even colder. Clear skies and mostly calm winds overnight cooled down the region.

Morning temperatures hovered just above freezing, sitting at 35 degrees at DFW, 33 at Lake Ray Roberts, 35 in Plano, 36 at Cedar Creek and 37 at Lake Tawakoni. Sunshine will help temperatures reach an afternoon high of 53 degrees.

story.title: Dallas Weather: Breezy, near-freezing ‘festive chill’ grips North Texas for Thanksgiving
story.summary: A "festive chill" is keeping North Texas bundled up in layers this Thanksgiving, with gusty winds making afternoon highs feel even colder. DALLAS - A "festive chill" is keeping North Texas bundled up in layers this Thanksgiving, with gusty winds making afternoon highs feel even colder. Clear skies and mostly calm winds overnight cooled down the region. Morning temperatures hovered just above freezing, sitting at 35 degrees at DFW, 33 at Lake Ray Roberts, 35 in Plano, 36 at Cedar Creek and 37 at Lake Tawakoni. Sunshine will help temperatures reach an afternoon high of 53 degrees. However, breezy northwest winds between 10 and 20 mph, with gusts reaching 25 to 30 mph, will make it feel closer to 50 degrees or the upper 40s.
